description: Canonical camera fixture for the Night Port scene. Gate 2's dry-run fakes this as a slow dolly-in via FFmpeg zoompan on the source still. Gate 3+ will produce this authoritatively via Project Lyra navigating a real USD scene.

camera.intrinsics_note: FOV chosen to match the source hero's apparent focal length (~50mm equivalent on full-frame). Adjust at Gate 3 when Lyra produces real intrinsics.

keyframes.note: Wide establishing — matches the source hero framing
Mid dolly — reveals more of the rail-line convergence
Close — the cyan holographic grid is now centered

note_for_downstream: This camera pose is consumed BOTH by Cosmos-Transfer2.5 (as a hint for maintaining geometric consistency across frames) AND by Seedance 2.0 i2v at Stage 6 (so the character motion animation is shot from a compatible viewpoint). The Event Translator's `camera_intent.dolly_in: true` output maps to this fixture's `motion_intent.dolly_in: true`.
